normal_coverage: Three independent full-H1024/Sq2/KV8/Q16/D128/WoK2048 integer fixtures; raw actual input/6MiB weights/output dumps, no reordering.
Every ordinary S write is checked against mathematical role golden, every real S ACK/read version is checked; native M A128/B512 layout and S32 READ carrier checked.
512 context S word ACKs must be unique and complete before any Wo request; head/token ordering and shared KV ownership require each K/V projection only once per Q pair.
Exact U16 EXP stored/replayed, causal count1/count2, split-half64 true gather and canonical coefficient E9, V axis unchanged.
Future_changed X1-only fixture checks token0 all16-head actual context256words and final actual Y128words against base bit-for-bit.
Only8 padding words are truly written/ACK once, tracked as immutable for every subsequent projection/QK/PV/Wo loader use.
Raw T256 words are interleaved X0[g]/X1[g], held through real S overwrite, heads and Wo; each take is captured at S258 and ACK before E residual service.
Final residual ACK gates raw RELEASE and second BEGIN; output commit/drain/release is real, successful DONE follows second RELEASE.
Normal base tests raw T write/commit stalls and rejecting duplicate BEGIN; boundary tests N/M/E response holds plus raw and output RELEASE backpressure.
fault_scope: Seven finite provider corruptions: index,last,future job,old job,seq,version,error; each first bad accepted beat is checked to cause zero additional S request/write.
Input bad index/last/old generation are rejected without any S request; admitted jobs retain exactly one identity-bound terminal, including prestart abort.
Real loader load_tiles0, native M reserved descriptor, native N opcode15, native E opcode14 errors are exercised; S helper response error is boundary injection, not native S error detection.
Raw and output T metadata are forced at real endpoint wires; bad metadata must not be consumed/published.
Reset and abort cases include input, weight, head/N hold, raw capture, output held/prefix and terminal ready/abort coincidence.
Raw T metadata corruption is injected only after both input RMS groups finish and the first projection weight request is offered, exercising head_t_violation rather than only RAW_SAVED admission.
evidence_limits: TB author did not run local or remote RTL compilation/simulation. Root runs source-bound server Verilator after source freeze.
Finite vectors/faults are not exhaustive arithmetic, protocol liveness or all-phase stale/reset isolation.
External provider must stop/coordinate after error; strict only-WEIGHT_RX acceptance does not implement automatic late-response drain.
Coordinated leaf reset is used on job errors/abort; actual host prefix is not rolled back; hard reset drops obligation without synthesizing DONE.

Synthetic fixed Fin10/weightFin7/epsilon_code1 integer profile, positions0/1, Sq2/no cache. Structural full selected Attention is not trained-model quality, framework bit-equivalence, full28layer inference, MEM or physical qualification.
One M/N/E/S/T is the chosen serial resource construction, not a proven minimum or throughput/PPA optimum; no general L5 network or complete permanent-product ROM/program union.
active_product_program: fixed selected Attention sequence, runtime tensor/gamma/coefficient/weight data and captured version are not boot-loaded program
saturation_input: Each fixture expected-saturated.hex is generated from stage clip OR and read by TB; no name-based saturation assumption.
